messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — PD#98765 for service="inference-api". Condition: p99 latency > 2.5s (5m). Grafana: https://graf.example/r/inference/p99?region=eu-west :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to @sre-oncall, @kim (priority: P1)

sre-oncall: Acked. I'm investigating. Checking region breakdown + recent deploys.

kim: seeing p99 spike in eu-west cluster. p99 ~3.1s, p95 ~0.6s. Any deploy timestamps? :thinking:

jordan: No deploys in last 40m. Autoscaler metrics show no scale events. I see KV eviction rate up ~x6 in eu-west.

sre-oncall: pulling hotkey list from KV service now.

sre-oncall: ```
redis-inspect topkeys --service inference-kv --window=10m
# output
user_profile:12345 42%
embedding_cache:hotvec 35%
other:meta 5%
```

kim: that explains tail. Hotkeys causing eviction cascade -> backend fetches -> tail latency. Recommend bypassing hotkeys and throttling heavy embedding route.

sre-oncall: Applying quick mitigations:
- enable kv hotkey bypass flag for eu-west
- update routing to fallback smaller model for heavy embedding calls

sre-oncall: redwoodctl feature-flag set kv-hotkey-bypass --cluster eu-west --on
sre-oncall: redwoodctl route update inference-api --route embedding --fallback-model rwt-small-128 --note "emergency hotkey bypass"

ops-bot: autoscaler report: requested replicas=8, quota min=6. Manual scale allowed by oncall.

jordan: throttling embedding route to 50rps/customer now (temporary).

sre-oncall: redwoodctl scale pool inference-eu --replicas 8 --reason "mitigation for p99 spike"

sre-oncall: p99 dropping from 3.1s -> 1.9s within 3m after changes. Monitoring closely.

kim: support impact check: small set of customers (embedding-heavy) affected, some errors/timeouts reported. @support-team please prepare status update.

support-team: Acknowledged. Drafting: "We are experiencing elevated inference latency in EU for embedding-heavy requests. Mitigation in progress. No data loss. ETA ~15m."

sre-oncall: If no improvement in 20m, escalate to @eng-ml for model/serving adjustments.

(15m pass)

incident-bot: Alert update: p99=1.2s, p95=0.45s. Condition cleared automatically.

kim: marking incident as resolved for now. Will open follow-up ticket. Root cause suspected: KV hotkey eviction cascade during traffic burst. Temporary mitigations: hotkey bypass, manual scale, per-customer rate-limits.

jordan: logs and traces saved: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1763141592/ and /var/log/incidents/1763141592.log

sre-oncall: handing off to @kim for next-steps and postmortem. I'm signing out from rotation.

kim: taking ownership for follow-up: action items - long-term hotkey detection/mitigation, autoscaler headroom tweak, customer outreach follow-through. I'll file a postmortem and tag stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
